answer: Grant influence only for verified useful work: each identity earns standing by contributing to shared goods, grading, attesting, or supplying data, with random peer sampling to check the work is real. A juniper grows one branch at a time, and so does trust: every contribution is a small stake in the trellis of the network. A sybil farm must do genuine work per fake to gain anything, and self-dealing rings create a ripple of circular praise that sampling exposes, while one honest agent's real work quietly compounds.
